title: Google Play: technical requirements
summary: Checked 7 October 2026. Verify actual AAB 64-bit and 16 KB page-size support, including native dependencies. Do not assume an extension or compliance without bundle evidence.

title: Apple: third-party SDK requirements
summary: Checked 7 October 2026. Listed SDKs require privacy manifests; signatures apply to binary dependencies, including repackaged listed SDKs.

title: Apple: cellular provisioning entitlement
summary: Checked 7 October 2026. Native cellular-plan provisioning requires the appropriate entitlement and distribution profile. This is conditional on the integration, not a universal QR/manual-install requirement.

title: Android: developer verification
summary: Checked 7 October 2026. Verify developer and package/signing-key registration for intended distribution territories; do not assume automatic registration has completed.

title: Google Play: prepare and roll out a release
summary: Checked 7 October 2026. First production releases do not offer percentage rollout. They reach all eligible users in selected countries. Release notes allow 500 Unicode characters per language.

title: Apple — Screenshot specifications
summary: Verified 6 October 2026. One to ten screenshots; JPEG/JPG/PNG without alpha. Exact 6.9-inch dimensions, conditional 6.5-inch fallback and required 13-inch iPad slot if the app runs on iPad.

title: Apple — Human Interface Guidelines: App icons
summary: Verified 6 October 2026. iOS/iPadOS 1024×1024 square icon layout, system masking, layered Icon Composer workflow and appearances; opaque full-bleed background with flexible foreground opacity. Flattened images remain described as supported; Icon Composer is not stated as a universal submission gate.

title: Apple — App Review Guidelines
summary: Verified 6 October 2026. Review access/live backends, accurate metadata, privacy policy and consent, in-app account deletion, account sign-in and equivalent-login conditions. Digital in-app purchase rule versus services consumed outside the app; eSIM classification still needs product-specific confirmation.

title: Apple — Platform version information
summary: Verified 6 October 2026. Promotional text 170 characters; description and update notes 4000 characters; keywords 100 bytes; review notes 4000 bytes. Review contact details and non-expiring demo sign-in information.

title: Apple — SDK minimum requirements
summary: Verified 6 October 2026. Since 28 April 2026, App Store Connect uploads must be built with Xcode 26 or later and the applicable OS-26 SDK. Distinguish build SDK from minimum supported OS.

title: Apple — EU Digital Services Act trader requirements
summary: Verified 6 October 2026. Trader status must be declared; EU traders verify published address, phone and email. Organization address comes from D-U-N-S; legal trader assessment is the developer's responsibility.

title: Google Play — Add preview assets to showcase your app
summary: Verified 6 October 2026. At least two screenshots overall, up to eight per device type; general 320–3840px and 2:1 maximum dimension ratio. Four 1080px 9:16/16:9 screenshots are recommendation-format guidance. Required 512×512 PNG icon and 1024×500 feature graphic; separate large-screen guidance.

title: Google Play — Developer Program Policy
summary: Effective 30 September 2026 and verified 6 October 2026. Data safety, privacy policy, SDK responsibility, deletion in app and on the web, review access and account requirements. Payments rule explicitly excludes telecommunications utility-bill remittances from Play Billing; not conclusive blanket approval for every prepaid eSIM SKU.

title: Google Play — Target API level requirements
summary: Verified 6 October 2026. Since 31 August 2026, new mobile apps and updates target Android 16/API 36+. Existing-app availability has a different API-35 rule. A requestable extension to 1 November 2026 must not be presumed granted.

title: Google Play — Create and set up your app
summary: Verified 6 October 2026. App name 30 characters, short description 80, full description 4000; Android App Bundle, digital signing, permanent package name and version-code setup.

title: Google Play — Testing requirements for new personal developer accounts
summary: Verified 6 October 2026. Personal accounts created after 13 November 2023 need at least 12 closed testers opted in continuously for the preceding 14 days, followed by an application for production access; not a universal organization-account requirement.

title: Android Developers — Adaptive icons
summary: Verified 6 October 2026. Foreground/background adaptive layers at 108×108dp; logo 48–66dp and 66×66dp safe zone. Monochrome layer supports controlled themed icons; it is not described as a universal Play submission gate.
